title: Binary cube point indicator
statement: For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $a,x\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$, where $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. Define the indicator of $a$ evaluated at $x$ by $\displaystyle \prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\begin{cases}x_i,&a_i=1,\\1-x_i,&a_i\ne 1.\end{cases}$
hypotheses_covered: Both $a$ and $x$ are functions from the coordinates $\{0,1,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
